competency_results.notes: every assertion carries its evidence records inline

competency_results.question: Which assertions conflict, supersede, or corroborate one another?
competency_results.notes: corroboration = duplicate canonical claims share one deterministic id

competency_results.question: Which possible entity matches remain unresolved?
Which entities and assertions fail validation?
What are the direct neighbors of a given entity?
competency_results.notes: sampled on the first canonical entity; callable for any id

competency_results.question: Which assertions involve a given entity, predicate, source, or time range?
competency_results.notes: sampled on the first entity and source; callable for any value

competency_results.question: Which one-hop and two-hop paths connect two entities?
competency_results.notes: traversal depth is bounded at two hops by design

competency_results.question: Which graph claims require human review?
competency_results.notes: identity reviews, disputed/unresolved and low-confidence assertions, error issues
